text: ③「おわる」か　Ａボタン　Ｂボタンで　かえた　ないように　なります。

structure.jp: ③「おわる」か　Ａボタン　Ｂボタンで
structure.en: ③ with "Cancel", or the A Button or B Button

structure.jp: かえた　ないように

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a thing tells you which thing. かえた　ないよう = 'the settings you changed'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: ないように　なります
patterns.explanation: になる after a thing says something changes into it. ないように　なります = 'it becomes those settings'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says you use it to do the action. Ａボタン　Ｂボタンで = 'with the A Button or the B Button'.
